# Vulnerabilities that vulnscan (tools/cmd/vulnscan) reports without failing. CONTRIBUTING.md
# says when to add an entry.
#
# One vulnerability per line, with four or more fields separated by spaces:
#
#   <ID> <module> <reason> <last day>
#
#   ID        the Go vulnerability database ID, such as GO-2026-1234
#   module    the module govulncheck reports it in, such as golang.org/x/net
#   reason    why the SDK is not exposed, in one or more words
#   last day  the last day the entry applies, in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DD
#
# vulnscan prints each accepted vulnerability with its reason, never accepts one in called code or
# in the standard library, fails on an entry after its last day, and fails on an entry that no
# tree reports any more, so remove an entry once its vulnerability is gone. Blank lines and lines
# that start with # are ignored.
